_comment: POST each payload to /rest/<store_view_code>/V1/eventing/eventSubscribe on the ACCS tenant,
or create them in Admin > System > Events > Events Subscriptions.
VERIFY the names first with GET /V1/eventing/supportedList — Adobe's docs use the bare
nowhere in Adobe's documentation and must not be assumed.
PaaS-only mechanisms (io_events.xml, bin/magento events:subscribe) do NOT apply to ACCS.
